title: She'sn
overview:
Let your feelings ride the winds of the seasons. She'sn is a romance adventure made up of four separate love stories, one for each season, and you can play them in any order you like. Spring brings meetings and partings in a forbidden love with your sister-in-law, summer a romance with your childhood friend, autumn a heated school romance, and winter a bittersweet, lonely love story. Read through each tale and make the choices that decide how it ends.

- Four seasonal stories, each with its own heroine
- Single player
- Memory backup save
- Rated for ages 18 and over
